name: io.github.nightmoose/contractgate
title: DataContractGate and AISchemaGate
description: DataContractGate ingest, ODCS, quarantine. AISchemaGate egress validation and repair.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.summary: DataContractGate: ingest data contracts, ODCS v3.1 and v3.2 validation, quarantine and replay. AISchemaGate: runtime LLM structured-output validation via egress_validate and violation-fed auto-repair.
